supersedes: design_guidelines.v2-navy-glass.json (navy/glassmorphism, retired) and .v1-espresso-gold.json (retired earlier). v3.0 (same file, same day) is corrected here against real applied mockups — see design_reference.
personality: Nivora Daylight — neo-utilitarian editorial, light-only, tactile paper-and-ink
personality_one_liner: Warm cream paper, sharp black ink outlines, hard offset shadows, one high-voltage amber accent. Feels like a premium archival tool, not a glossy consumer app.
theme_mode_note: Daylight-forward by design. Dark mode is explicitly deferred, not designed. Settings > Appearance keeps only 'Light' active for now; hide or disable Dark/System until a dark companion palette is designed as its own pass.

source_of_truth.prd: memory/Velo PRD v1.1.md (section 42 UI/UX, 43 Navigation, 47 Themes)
source_of_truth.brand: memory/assets/Velo_Complete_Vector_Brand_Kit/brand/VELO_BRAND_SPEC.md and memory/assets/Velo_Brand_Kit_Sheet.png (logo/icon unchanged by this reskin)
source_of_truth.design_reference: Primary, authoritative source: 12 user-supplied Stitch-generated screen mockups (HTML + PNG, Tailwind + Material 3 tokens) under the 'Nivora' style, one per PRD screen. Token values, exact px, and component structure below are read directly off those mockups, not guessed from the earlier prose-only theme docs. Where the two earlier text-only design docs (a generic neo-brutalist spec and a 'Nivora Daylight' spec) differ from the mockups, the mockups win — they are what the user actually approved as 'how this applies to the screen'.
source_of_truth.reference_screens_path: The 12 mockups were supplied as stitch_premium_mobile_app_ui_design.zip (one folder per screen, each with code.html + screen.png). Re-extract from the chat upload if needed; they are not committed to the repo.
source_of_truth.implementation: frontend/src/design/theme.ts (same keys as color.light below; no color literals in components)

notes: Two near-blacks, both real in the mockups, not a typo: `border`/`divider` (#121212) is the pure structural ink used for every border and offset shadow; `onSurface`/text tokens (#1C1B1B) is the very slightly warmer M3 on-surface used for body text. Keep them distinct — components use `colors.border` for outlines/shadows and `colors.onSurface` for text, never the other way round.

`brandPrimary` (#FFC800, M3 'primary-container') is the CTA/active fill. `mutedAmber` (#755B00, M3 'primary') is a separate, muted amber used only for small accent-tinted labels/icons (e.g. a 'Clipboard Link' eyebrow, a resolver icon) — never as a button fill.

success/warning use the M3 tertiary (green) and secondary (rust-orange) pairs respectively, not a generic traffic-light green/amber — this matches every status chip in the mockups (DOWNLOADING = amber `primary-fixed`, PROCESSING = mint `tertiary-fixed`, RETRY/Attempt = orange `secondary-container`, hard failure = `error`/`errorSurface`).
Status *Border tokens are #1C1B1B (a thin ink outline on the chip), not a tinted border — the mockups never use a colored border on a status pill, only a colored fill.

gradients.usage: None. Flat fills only — the brand-gradient CTA from the retired navy theme is gone. Primary CTA is a flat brandPrimary (#FFC800) fill with a black border and hard offset shadow, never a gradient.

logo_only.note: Exact logomark colors from the brand spec are unchanged by this reskin. Do not use as UI tokens.

status_colors.downloading_active: brandPrimary fill (amber), ink text — matches the mockups' 'DOWNLOADING' chip (M3 primary-fixed).
status_colors.processing: successSurface fill (mint), success text — matches the 'PROCESSING' chip and progress % text (M3 tertiary/tertiary-fixed).
status_colors.file_missing: warningSurface fill, onWarningSurface text — same family as failed_retryable (a 'you need to act' family), distinguished by icon + label, not a separate hue.
status_colors.failed_retryable: warningSurface fill (orange), onWarningSurface text — matches the mockups' 'RETRY' / 'Attempt 2 of 4' badges (M3 secondary-container).
status_colors.source_unavailable: error text on errorSurface fill — matches 'AUTH_REQUIRED' etc. badges (M3 error-container) and the error circle badge (solid `error` fill, white '!').
status_colors.note: Maps to PRD section 36 (green / yellow / blue / red) but the mockups collapse it to 3 chip families (amber=active, mint=healthy/done, orange=needs-attention) plus a 4th solid-red for hard failure. Always pair color with an icon and label (accessibility). Status chips use a *Surface fill + a plain #1C1B1B ink border, never a raw opacity tint.

rules: Single-family typographic system: Plus Jakarta Sans for everything (display, headings, body, labels) — confirmed as the only font loaded across all 12 mockups.

JetBrains Mono (fallback ui-monospace/SFMono-Regular) for hash strings, file paths (/Velo/YouTube/...), timestamps, bitrates and resolution specs, and anywhere digits update live (speed/ETA/size) so they do not jitter. The mockups themselves don't use a mono font (they're Material-3-generated, not literally Nivora-specific on this point) — keep JetBrains Mono per the prose design docs since it is strictly better for jitter-free live digits and Velo already ships tabular-number handling.
Overline/label-sm (section anchors, category headers, eyebrow text) is ExtraBold 11px, uppercase, +0.05em tracking — exact mockup value (not +0.08em as earlier drafted).

Fonts installed and loaded: @expo-google-fonts/plus-jakarta-sans (500/600/700/800) + @expo-google-fonts/jetbrains-mono (500/600), wired in src/app/_layout.tsx's useFonts(). Poppins and Inter packages are removed.

spacing.rule: 4px-based modular scale. Use sm-md (8-12) inside dense telemetry cards, md-lg (12-16) between macro sections — matches the mockups' `gutter`/`margin` (16px) and `space-md` (16px)/`space-sm` (8px) tokens.

radius_tokens.note: Corrected against the mockups' actual Tailwind config (borderRadius DEFAULT 4px, lg 8px, xl 12px, full 9999px) — earlier draft's 14/20/28 scale was invented, not sourced.

elevation.note: No blurred drop-shadows on cards/rows/buttons/sheets. Depth = a 1.5px-2px solid ink (`colors.border`, #121212) border plus a hard, non-blurred offset shadow. Confirmed exact values from the mockups: resting card `2px 2px 0 #121212`; small chips/icon-badges `1px 1px 0` or `1.5px 1.5px 0`; primary CTA / emphasized input `2.5px 2.5px 0` to `3px 3px 0`; raised sheets/dialogs `4px 4px 0` over the `scrim`. Press/active state: the element translates by exactly the resting shadow's offset (so a 2px-shadow element translates (2,2), a 1.5px one translates (1.5,1.5)) and the shadow collapses to none — this is the theme's one universal interaction rule.
elevation.chrome_exception: The fixed top header and the bottom tab bar are the ONE place this theme uses translucency: `background: surface at 90% opacity + backdrop-blur` (confirmed in all 12 mockups: `bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xl`), with a very soft `shadow-[0_1px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]` (header) / `shadow-[0_-2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]` (tab bar) — a normal soft shadow, not the tactile-offset style, and no ink border on that edge. This overrides the 'no blur anywhere' instruction in the earlier prose-only v3.0 draft; everything else (cards, rows, sheets, chips, buttons) stays fully opaque with the tactile-offset style, zero blur.
elevation.replaces: glassmorphism (v2) — GlassCard as a full-surface effect is gone. expo-blur is now used only for the header/tab-bar chrome per chrome_exception, not on content cards.

navigation.note: The mockups' own nav uses a different, generic 5-tab IA (Acquire / Resolve / Source / Library / Queue) invented by the design tool for a template product — it doesn't match Velo's actual routes (no Tools/Settings tab, 'Resolve' and 'Source' aren't tabs in our app). Keep our real IA and routes; borrow only the mockups' VISUAL tab-bar treatment below.
navigation.style: Translucent bg-surface/90 + blur tab bar (see elevation.chrome_exception), 64px tall, no ink border. Each tab is a `flex-1` pill (rounded-full). Active tab: filled brandPrimary pill (`neo-shadow-active` = 1.5px 1.5px 0 ink) behind icon+label, bold text. Inactive tabs: mutedSecondary icon + label, no fill, no shadow.

icon_set.shipped: MaterialCommunityIcons (@expo/vector-icons) — unchanged from earlier phases; do not add a new icon font for this reskin.
icon_set.mockups_use: Google 'Material Symbols Outlined' (a variable font not available in @expo/vector-icons). This is a real gap between the mockups and what the app can render today.
icon_set.instruction: When implementing a screen, map each Material-Symbols icon name in the mockup to the closest MaterialCommunityIcons name (e.g. `content_paste_go` -> `content-paste`, `history_edu` -> `history`, `radar` -> `radar` (exists), `offline_bolt` -> `lightning-bolt`, `hourglass_top` -> `timer-sand`, `hub` -> `source-branch` or `lan`, `terminal` -> `console`, `tune` -> `tune` (exists), `verified` -> `check-decagram`). Do not block a screen on an exact icon match; pick the nearest MaterialCommunityIcons glyph and move on. Only revisit adding Material Symbols as a bundled variable font if icon mismatches become a real design complaint after the reskin ships.

glassmorphism.note: See elevation.chrome_exception. Blur is allowed ONLY on the fixed header and bottom tab bar (translucent surface + backdrop-blur, confirmed in every mockup). It is NOT allowed anywhere else — no GlassCard, no blurred content cards, no blurred sheets/toasts. This corrects v3.0's blanket 'no glass' rule, which the mockups themselves don't follow.

platform_libraries.blur: expo-blur — header + bottom tab bar chrome only, per glassmorphism.enabled
platform_libraries.native_controls: @expo/ui (BottomSheet, Picker, Slider, Switch, Menu) — restyle to flat/ink borders where @expo/ui allows custom colors; fall back to a custom tactile control only where it does not.

components.Header: Fixed, translucent (see chrome_exception), 64px tall (`h-16`), safe-area top padding. Left: logo mark + wordmark (+ optional 'PRO' pill badge when Premium active). Right: contextual icon buttons (search/profile), each a 44x44 hit target.
components.Card: surfaceTertiary (#FFFFFF) fill (or surfaceInset #FAF8F5 for a quieter/inset card), 1.5px solid border(#121212), radius sm (8), tactile-offset shadow 2px 2px 0 #121212. Internal sections separated by a 1.5px solid border divider rule, not a soft line.
components.PrimaryButton: brandPrimary (#FFC800) fill, onBrandPrimary (#1C1B1B) text, 1.5-2px solid border, radius sm-md (8-12), shadow 2-3px offset. Press: translate by the shadow offset, shadow to none. Full-width for main CTAs (e.g. 'DOWNLOAD (1.42 GB)'), compact/icon-only (h-8/h-10 square) for inline actions.
components.SecondaryButton: surfaceInset (#FAF8F5) or white fill, onSurface text, 1.5px solid border, radius sm-md, shadow 1-2px offset. Press: translate by the shadow offset.
components.DestructiveButton: errorSurface (#FFDAD6) fill, onErrorSurface (#93000A) text, 1px solid border, radius sm-md, no offset shadow (quieter than primary/secondary so it never reads as the default action).
components.GhostButton: Transparent, no border, no shadow at rest. Hover/active reveals surfaceSecondary fill + 1.5px solid border.
components.UrlInputBar: Outer surfaceTertiary card, 1.5px solid border, radius sm, shadow 2.5px 2.5px 0 (slightly heavier than a normal card since it's the primary action surface). Inner input well: surfaceInset (#FAF8F5) fill, 1.5px solid border, radius sm, small inset top-left shadow. Focus: border stays solid ink, brandPrimary/mutedAmber icon accent. Trailing Analyze button is a compact PrimaryButton.
components.MediaTile: expo-image thumbnail, 1.5px solid ink border, radius sm, mandatory top-to-bottom scrim (transparent to onSurfaceInverse@70%) before overlaid text, title (Plus Jakarta Sans Bold), duration pill (bottom-right, dark pill/white text, mono digits), format/quality pill (top-left, brandTertiary or status-colored, ink border).
components.SourceRow: surfaceTertiary row card, 1.5px solid border, thumb, title, creator - platform (caption, mutedSecondary), StatusChip, overflow menu (Download, Redownload, Open Source, Copy URL, Share). Mockup pattern: thumb+details on top, a `border-t-[1.5px]` divider, then an action strip (platform dot+label left, Inspect/quick-action buttons right).
components.DownloadRow: surfaceTertiary card, 1.5px solid border, radius sm, shadow 2px 2px 0, striped progress track (`h-3 rounded-full border-1.5px ink`, filled portion is brandPrimary or successSurface depending on state, square/pill ends per the track's own radius not the fill), right-aligned Pause/Resume/Cancel as a small square tactile button, tabular mono speed/ETA/size below the bar. Failure rows sit inside an `errorSurface/30%`-tinted card and carry an Attempt counter chip.
components.StatusChip: Pill (radius 999) or small rect (radius xs), plain 1px #1C1B1B ink border, icon + label, semantic *Surface token fill per status_colors — never a flat opacity tint.
components.PillTag: Small pill/rect, 1px solid ink, label-sm ExtraBold uppercase +0.05em tracking. Technical spec pills (resolution/codec/fps) use a solid ink fill with white text; category/status pills use the semantic *Surface fill + ink border pair.
components.FormatRow: Resolution, label (4K/QHD/Full HD/HD), codec/container (mono), estimated size + speed (mono, right-aligned bold); selected row gets a 2px solid ink border (up from 1.5px) and brandTertiary (#FFF7D6) fill — no glow, no gradient.
components.QualityPresetControl: Segmented control, 1.5px solid ink border around the group, 1px dividers between segments; active segment = brandPrimary fill.
components.WaveformTrimmer: Card (radius sm, shadow 2px 2px 0). Header row: 'Timeline Extraction' overline + 'Selected: 02:31.00' headline left, Loop toggle + Play button (square, brandPrimary fill) right. Below: a `h-24` surfaceContainerHigh well (radius sm, small inset shadow) holding two layers of thin rounded vertical bars — an inactive layer at ~40% opacity in mutedSecondary, and an active-selection layer (brandTertiary@30% background band) with full-opacity onSurface bars inside the selected in/out range. Used by Tools > Trim and Tools > Extract Audio.
components.PremiumTimer: Mono numerals, brandPrimary accent when active, 'Watch Ad +1 Hour' as a SecondaryButton.
components.EmptyState: Ink-line logomark illustration + one line of copy (body) + one PrimaryButton or GhostButton CTA.
components.Toast: surfaceTertiary card, 1.5px solid border, shadow 4px 4px 0 (raised tier), error variant carries a Retry SecondaryButton. No blur (toasts are content, not chrome).
components.Switch: Track 38x22, 1.5px solid ink outline. Off: surfaceSecondary track, white knob with ink outline. On: brandPrimary (or successSurface for a 'safe/verified' toggle) track, ink knob outline, tactile offset shadow on the knob only.
components.Checkbox: 18x18 square, radius xs (4), 1.5px solid ink, white fill, shadow 1.5px 1.5px 0. Checked: brandPrimary fill + ink checkmark.
components.Radio: 18x18 circle, 1.5px solid ink. Checked: solid ink inner dot on a brandPrimary ring.
components.IconButton: MANDATORY for any icon control placed over a thumbnail, hero image, video frame, blurred artwork, or any other content whose color isn't controlled by us — never a bare tinted icon directly on top of it. Opaque circle (default 44x44, `iconSize` 22), surfaceTertiary fill, 1.5px solid ink border, tactile-offset shadow (2px), ink icon. Guarantees contrast no matter what the underlying image looks like at that exact spot. Found missing 2026-09-23 on Source Details' native transparent header back button, which sat directly over the hero photo and disappeared whenever the photo's top edge was dark — a bug invisible in review/screenshots that only showed up per-image on a real device, exactly the kind of thing that makes an app feel unfinished. `frontend/src/components/icon-button.tsx`. Used by: Source Details' header back button (via `headerLeft`), Player's Close/back control. Any future screen with a header/controls over media (hero banners, video thumbnails, cover art) must use this, not `headerTintColor` alone and not a raw `Pressable` + icon.

screens.purpose: One link to Detect to Resolve to Choose. Fast, obvious primary action.

states.loading: Ink-outlined spinner (no gradient ring) inside the URL card while analyzing.
states.empty: Ink-line logomark illustration with 'Paste a link to get started.'
states.error: Toast (raised tactile card) with failure reason and the actions allowed for that failure code.

Clipboard-detected banner card (brandTertiary fill) if a link is on the clipboard. UrlInputBar. 3-up preset shortcut grid (Audio Ingest / Link Only / Batch List, each a tinted Card). Active-download mini widget (striped progress + ETA) when something is running. Supported-platforms horizontal pill ribbon + one engine-status Card. Recent Source Captures: list of SourceRow-style capture cards with an action strip.

screens.name: Library

states.loading: surfaceSecondary skeleton grid (flat fill, no shimmer gradient — a simple opacity pulse is fine).
states.empty: 'Your library is empty.' + CTA to Home.

screens.purpose: Tactical queue: active, waiting, failed, completed.

A DOWNLOADING row shows the amber status chip + striped progress; a PROCESSING row (post-download remux/extract) shows the mint chip + tertiary progress; a failed row sits in an errorSurface@40%-tinted card with a RETRY/Attempt chip and a bold error badge with the failure code (e.g. AUTH_REQUIRED). Section headers Active / Waiting / Failed / Completed as overline labels.

Trim/Extract Audio use the WaveformTrimmer component. Duplicates uses side-by-side comparison cards with a size/hash readout and a Purge Candidate DestructiveButton. Reorganize/Storage use a token-syntax path builder Card + a folder-tree preview.

states.loading: Blurred artwork (this is content blur, not UI glassmorphism — still fine) + ink-outline spinner
states.error: Fallback artwork with 'Unable to play media.'

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Appearance, downloads, organization, premium, sync, about.
screens.layout: Grouped sections as Cards (use @expo/ui where it allows tactile restyling): Appearance (Light only for now — Dark/System entries hidden or disabled per theme_mode_note), Downloads (Wi-Fi only, concurrency, default quality), Organization (folder + filename templates), Premium (timer, watch ad boost), Sync & account, About.

screens_out_of_scope_for_now: 3 mockups map to features not in Velo's current PRD/roadmap and should NOT be built from: velo_resolver_manager_engine_health (a multi-resolver priority/cookie-vault admin screen — Velo's worker resolver selection is automatic, no user-facing manager), velo_batch_ingestion_channel_bulk (bulk/channel batch downloads — a later Premium feature, not scheduled), velo_auth_sandbox_cookie_vault (an embedded cookie-sniffing webview for member-gated content — conflicts with the 'never bypass auth/DRM' rule in CLAUDE.md; do not build). Keep them only as visual style reference (color/shadow/radius), not as screens to implement.

principles: Press/active feedback is a snap, not a spring: translate by the element's own resting-shadow offset and collapse the shadow to none in ~80-100ms, linear/ease-out — this IS the primary tactile feedback of the whole theme, must feel instant.
Hover/focus (where it applies, e.g. external keyboard/mouse) translates -1,-1 and expands the shadow by +1px.
Sheets/toasts use a short rise (translateY + opacity), not a blur fade.
Respect Reduce Motion: replace movement with an instant state swap.
motion.progress_bar: Animated on the UI thread from a shared value fed by throttled (max 4 Hz) native progress events. Track: `h-3 rounded-full` with a 1.5px ink border and small inner padding; fill is inset within that border, flat brandPrimary (active) or successSurface (processing), rounded-full ends matching the track (the mockups round the track, not the earlier draft's 'square ends' claim — corrected).

accessibility.contrast: Body text at least 4.5:1 on its surface. Ink-on-cream and ink-on-amber both pass comfortably; onBrandPrimary is always #1C1B1B (never white) because #FFC800 is too light for white text.
accessibility.touch_targets: At least 44x44 dp — confirmed in the mockups (`min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px]` on icon buttons). The compact 18x18 checkbox/radio glyphs still need a 44x44 hit slop.
accessibility.status: Never rely on color alone: icon + label, reinforced by the ink border so status is legible even at low vision / grayscale.
accessibility.dynamic_type: Layouts must survive 130% font scale — tactile cards have fixed-looking borders/shadows but must not clip text; let card height grow.
accessibility.controls_over_media: A control's contrast can never depend on what a user's thumbnail/photo/video happens to look like at that pixel — that fails silently and differently for every piece of content, which is exactly the kind of bug that erodes a 'premium' feel because it's invisible in testing until the wrong image shows up. Every icon control over a thumbnail, hero image, video frame or artwork uses the IconButton component (components.IconButton) — an opaque backdrop, not a bare tinted icon on `headerTintColor`/`headerTransparent` or a raw `Pressable`. This applies to header back buttons, close buttons, any future overlay control (favorite-on-thumbnail, more-menu-on-hero, etc).

images.android_adaptive: memory/assets/Velo_Complete_Vector_Brand_Kit/android/ (background / foreground XML) — unchanged by this reskin, per the user's request to keep icons the same
images.splash: Cream surface (#FCF9F8) with centered logomark + wordmark + tagline 'Save. Convert. Organize.', ink-outline treatment instead of the old navy/gradient glow.
images.hero_glow: Removed. No radial gradient glow anywhere in Nivora Daylight — flat surface only.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use only tokens from color.light via useTheme(). Zero color literals in components. There is no color.dark in this version — see theme_mode_note.
The retired navy/glassmorphism (v2) and espresso/gold (v1) palettes must not appear anywhere.
Plus Jakarta Sans for everything (display through body/labels); JetBrains Mono for hashes/paths/timestamps/live numeric metrics.

Blur/translucency is allowed ONLY on the fixed Header and bottom TabBar (see elevation.chrome_exception). Everywhere else: zero blur, zero glass, zero gradients — depth is a solid ink border + hard offset shadow only.
Every thumbnail still gets the mandatory vertical scrim before overlaying text.

Never place a bare tinted icon (headerTintColor, or a plain Pressable+icon with no backdrop) over a thumbnail/hero/video/artwork — use IconButton (components.IconButton, accessibility.controls_over_media). A native transparent header back button is the easy way to miss this: override headerLeft with IconButton whenever headerTransparent is true and the header sits over media.
Sheets, pickers, toggles and sliders: try @expo/ui first, restyle its colors to the ink/amber tokens; only build a custom tactile control where @expo/ui cannot take custom colors/borders.
Every status uses icon + label + color per status_colors (a *Surface fill + a plain ink border), never a raw opacity tint.
Press states must show the translate-by-shadow-offset + shadow-collapse tactile feedback on every bordered/shadowed interactive element (buttons, cards that are pressable, chips).
Map each mockup's Material-Symbols icon name to the nearest MaterialCommunityIcons glyph per icon_set.instruction — do not add a new icon font.
Do NOT build the 3 screens listed in screens_out_of_scope_for_now.

This file only changes the visual skin (color/type/shape/elevation/motion). Do not change the 5-tab navigation IA or screen routes as part of applying it — the mockups' own nav labels are a generic template artifact, ignore them (see navigation.note).

Apply screen-by-screen once this file and theme.ts are approved; do not big-bang every screen in one pass. Cross-check each screen against its `mockup` field's screen.png/code.html for exact spacing/copy before marking it done.
